physics-11.chapter: Motion in a Straight Line & Plane

formulas.name: Equations of Uniform Motion
formulas.latex: v = u + at,   s = ut + ½ at²,   v² = u² + 2as
formulas.desc: Valid only for constant acceleration along a straight line.

formulas.name: Displacement in n-th second
formulas.desc: Distance traveled between t = n−1 and t = n seconds.

formulas.name: Projectile Maximum Height
formulas.desc: Peak altitude in parabolic trajectory without air drag.

formulas.name: Horizontal Range
formulas.desc: Maximum range occurs at θ = 45°, where R_max = u² / g.

formulas.name: Time of Flight
formulas.desc: Total time aloft from launch until return to launch height.

formulas.name: Newton's Second Law
formulas.desc: SI Unit: Newton (N) = kg m s⁻². Momentum p = m·v.

formulas.name: Limiting Static Friction
formulas.desc: Always opposes impending relative motion; μ_s > μ_k.

formulas.name: Kinetic Friction
formulas.desc: Constant opposing friction during active relative sliding.

formulas.name: Optimum Banking Angle
formulas.desc: Angle where normal force alone provides required centripetal acceleration.

formulas.name: Maximum Safe Speed on Banked Road
formulas.latex: v_max = √[ r·g · (μ + tan θ) / (1 − μ tan θ) ]
formulas.desc: Highest speed before vehicle slips outwards.

formulas.name: Work-Energy Theorem
formulas.latex: W_net = ΔK = ½ m v_f² − ½ m v_i²
formulas.desc: Work done by ALL forces equals the total change in kinetic energy.

formulas.name: Potential Energy of Spring
formulas.desc: Hooke's restoring force: F = −k x.

formulas.name: Instantaneous Power
formulas.latex: P = dW/dt = F · v = F v cos θ
formulas.desc: SI unit: Watt (W) = J s⁻¹. 1 horsepower (hp) = 746 W.

formulas.name: Universal Gravitation
formulas.desc: G = 6.674 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻².

formulas.name: Acceleration due to Gravity
formulas.desc: At depth d: g(d) = g(1 − d/R). At height h ≪ R: g(h) = g(1 − 2h/R).

formulas.name: Escape Velocity
formulas.desc: Independent of projectile mass and projection angle.

formulas.name: Orbital Velocity
formulas.desc: Speed for stable low Earth circular orbit.

formulas.name: Kepler's Third Law
formulas.desc: Square of orbital period is proportional to cube of semi-major axis.

formulas.name: First Law of Thermodynamics
formulas.latex: ΔQ = ΔU + ΔW = n C_v ΔT + P ΔV
formulas.desc: Conservation of energy for closed thermodynamic system.

formulas.name: Isothermal Work Done
formulas.latex: W_iso = nRT ln(V₂ / V₁) = 2.303 nRT log₁₀(P₁ / P₂)
formulas.desc: Isothermal process: temperature constant, ΔU = 0.

formulas.name: Adiabatic Equation
formulas.latex: PV^γ = const,   TV^(γ−1) = const,   W = nR(T₁ − T₂) / (γ − 1)
formulas.desc: γ = C_p / C_v. Monoatomic gas = 5/3, Diatomic gas = 7/5.

formulas.name: Carnot Engine Efficiency
formulas.desc: Temperatures T_L and T_H must strictly be in Kelvin (K).

formulas.name: Simple Pendulum Period
formulas.desc: Independent of bob mass for small angular amplitudes.

formulas.name: Spring-Mass Oscillator
formulas.desc: Total mechanical energy E = ½ k A² is strictly conserved.

formulas.name: Electric Dipole on Axial Line
formulas.desc: r ≫ 2a. Directed along dipole moment p = 2qa.

formulas.name: Electric Dipole on Equatorial Line
formulas.desc: E_axial = 2 · E_equatorial at identical distances.

formulas.name: Gauss's Law
formulas.desc: Total electric flux depends only on net enclosed charge.

formulas.name: Parallel Plate Capacitance
formulas.desc: With dielectric slab of constant K filling the plate gap.

formulas.name: Electrostatic Energy Stored
formulas.latex: U = ½ C V² = Q² / (2C) = ½ Q V
formulas.desc: Energy density u = ½ ε₀ E².

formulas.name: Drift Velocity & Current
formulas.latex: I = n e A v_d,   v_d = (e E τ) / m
formulas.desc: τ is the mean relaxation time between lattice collisions.

formulas.name: Temperature Coefficient of Resistance
formulas.desc: α > 0 for metallic conductors, α < 0 for semiconductors.

formulas.name: Balanced Wheatstone Bridge
formulas.desc: Zero current flows through galvanometer when bridge is balanced.

formulas.name: Lens Maker's Formula
formulas.desc: Strictly follow Cartesian sign conventions.

formulas.name: Young's Double Slit Fringe Width
formulas.desc: Angular fringe width θ = λ / d.

formulas.name: Einstein's Photoelectric Equation
formulas.latex: h ν = Φ₀ + K_max = h ν₀ + e V₀
formulas.desc: V₀ is stopping potential; h = 6.626 × 10⁻³⁴ J s.

formulas.name: de Broglie Wavelength
formulas.desc: For an electron accelerated through potential difference V.

formulas.name: Bohr Orbit Radius & Energy
formulas.desc: Ground state ionization energy of hydrogen is 13.6 eV.

formulas.name: Radioactive Decay Law
formulas.desc: Mean lifetime τ = 1 / λ = 1.44 · T_(1/2).

formulas.name: Molarity (M)
formulas.desc: Temperature-dependent concentration unit.

formulas.name: Molality (m)
formulas.desc: Temperature-independent concentration unit.

formulas.name: Mole Fraction (x)
formulas.desc: Dimensionless mole ratio.

formulas.name: Gibbs Free Energy
formulas.desc: ΔG < 0: Spontaneous; ΔG = 0: Equilibrium; ΔG > 0: Non-spontaneous.

formulas.name: Standard Cell Potential & Equilibrium
formulas.latex: ΔG° = −RT ln K_eq = −2.303 RT log₁₀ K_eq = −n F E°_cell
formulas.desc: F = 96,485 C mol⁻¹.

formulas.name: Henderson-Hasselbalch Equation
formulas.desc: Buffer capacity is maximized when [salt] = [acid] (pH = pKa).

formulas.name: Relative Lowering of Vapour Pressure
formulas.desc: Raoult's law for non-volatile solute.

formulas.name: Boiling Point Elevation & Freezing Depression
formulas.latex: ΔT_b = i · K_b · m,   ΔT_f = i · K_f · m
formulas.desc: K_b = molal ebullioscopic constant; K_f = cryoscopic constant.

formulas.name: Osmotic Pressure
formulas.desc: Accurate method to determine molar mass of polymers and proteins.

formulas.name: Van 't Hoff Factor
formulas.desc: α is degree of dissociation or association.

formulas.name: Nernst Equation at 298 K
formulas.desc: At equilibrium Q = K_eq and E_cell = 0.

formulas.name: Kohlrausch's Law
formulas.desc: Molar conductivity at infinite dilution is additive.

formulas.name: First Order Rate Constant
formulas.desc: Half-life of 1st-order reaction is independent of initial concentration.

formulas.name: Arrhenius Activation Energy
formulas.desc: Rate roughly doubles for every 10°C temperature rise.

formulas.name: Classification Criteria
formulas.latex: Cell Structure + Thallus + Nutrition + Reproduction + Phylogeny
formulas.desc: 5 Kingdoms: Monera (Prokaryotes), Protista, Fungi (Chitin wall), Plantae, Animalia.

formulas.name: Monohybrid Cross Ratios
formulas.desc: F2 cross Tt × Tt yields TT (1), Tt (2), tt (1).

formulas.name: Dihybrid Cross Ratio
formulas.desc: Demonstrates Mendel's Law of Independent Assortment.

formulas.name: Genetic Code Numbers
formulas.desc: Initiation codon: AUG (codes for Methionine in eukaryotes).

formulas.name: Chargaff's Equivalence Rule
formulas.desc: Valid strictly for double-stranded DNA (dsDNA).

formulas.name: Hardy-Weinberg Equilibrium
formulas.desc: Allele frequencies remain constant in absence of evolutionary forces.

formulas.name: Lindeman's 10% Trophic Law
formulas.desc: Only ~10% of energy transfers between trophic levels; pyramid is always upright.
